subject: SwapIt Sustainable Fashion Membership
overview: Anna Callahan interviewed Stephanie Johnson, owner of SwapIt, about the store's mission to reduce textile waste. They discussed the transition to a membership-based clothing swap model and the store's operational changes during the COVID-19 pandemic.

items.title: Origins and Mission
items.summary: Owner Stephanie Johnson described starting SwapIt to keep clothing out of landfills by providing an affordable and convenient secondhand shopping experience.

items.title: Styling Services and COVID-19 Adaptations
items.summary: The store suspended its personal styling sessions and implemented safety protocols, including capacity limits and health screenings, in response to the pandemic.

items.title: Membership Model and Holiday Gifts
items.summary: The business offers a $147 annual membership that allows for unlimited one-for-one clothing swaps, which Johnson promoted as a sustainable gift option.

items.title: Website and Donation Policy
items.summary: Memberships are available through the company's website, though clothing intake is currently restricted to active members due to COVID-19 constraints.
